changeinfo.changes: This version contains the following changes: - Fixed the console hanging when FPKGi+ was closed from the home screen after watching trailers - Game pages no longer slow down after a trailer: the video player is closed when you leave a trailer or go to the home screen - The update blocker pauses while the console goes into rest mode and for a minute after it wakes - If the console ever stops while the update blocker is reading the download queue, the next start notes it; after a second time, the background blocker switches itself off

This version contains the following changes: - Screenshots and trailers on each game's page, from the PlayStation Store. Browse the screenshots full screen, and stream trailers in the app with sound - Trailer controls: Cross pauses, tap Left or Right to skip 10 seconds, hold to scrub with the bar - Game details (overview, publisher, release date, genre, players, age rating) now come from the PlayStation Store, found by title ID in your region's store. Only details that are known are shown - PS1, PS2 and PSP titles the store does not carry get their in-game screenshots from libretro-thumbnails - Required firmware is shown as, for example, 9.00+

This version contains the following changes: - New Installed tab: every installed game and app from your content lists in one place, with a Show filter (All, Games, Homebrew and so on) in Sort & filter - Blocks PlayStation Network updates for games installed as fake packages, which do not run and stop the game starting. It works in the background, with FPKGi+ closed and while you play. System software updates and games you own are left alone. Turn it off in Settings > Pre-flight checks - Custom HTTP headers and cookies for content lists and downloads, for servers that need sign-in (config.json: PREFERENCES > HTTP_HEADERS and HTTP_HEADERS_BY_HOST) - The controller works again after returning from the home screen or a system dialog

This version contains the following changes: - Fixed Archive.org downloads failing with "requires sign-in (401)" after signing in while the background downloader was already running. Signing in or out now reaches the background downloader within a few seconds

This version contains the following changes: - Background downloads: downloads keep going after FPKGi+ is closed and while you play other games. In rest mode they pause, and continue by themselves when the console wakes - A notification appears when a download finishes or fails, wherever you are on the console - Starting a game no longer pauses your downloads - New in Settings > System: Background downloads (on or off) and Background downloader (status, restart, remove) - FPKGi+ now appears under Library > Applications - Update History notes for FPKGi+, shown here

First release of FPKGi+, a package browser, downloader and installer for jailbroken PS4 consoles: - Browse FPKGi-format content lists with cover art, details and PS1 / PS2 / PSP / PS4 cases - Resumable downloads with up to 8 connections, to the console or a USB drive - Install, launch, update and delete titles from inside the app - Built-in list of open-source homebrew, with update checks against each project's latest release - Checks for FPKGi+ updates in Settings > System > Software update - Modern and Retro arcade themes
